title: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool
scope: Story-first rewrite; all32 intended book pages. Not an illustrated replacement PDF or runtime change.

songs.title: A Place for Me and You
lyrics: Sing with you, sing with me.
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.

songs.title: A Little Swimming Way
lyrics: Catch the star and let it sway.
Leave a beat and keep it slow.

pages.title: Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool

panels.stage: Cover: Roshan leads a low swimming arc; Rumi, Hana and Nari behind her, Duri beside her. Pearl bridge and shell stage establish one connected under-pool city. Cover art is a separate pending view.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: An undersea adventure with Rumi

panels.stage: Pool-room establishing view. Preserve the seahorse fountain and turning rainbow.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The castle's candle was still missing. In Rumi's pool, the rainbow kept turning.

panels.stage: Roshan watches Rumi warm up, then touches her own throat. Invitation has a real personal purpose.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Come sing with us tonight!

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: What if my voice is too little?

panels.stage: Rumi offers a hand; Roshan chooses to take it.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: You can start beside me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan wanted to try. She took a breath and followed Rumi down.

panels.stage: Broad geography: bridge/tram left, music room centre, bathhouse nearby, shell stage with lower current arch right. Pool portal remains above the city.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Below the pool lay curved roofs, lantern lanes and gardens of waving kelp.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: We're still in Pearl Castle?

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Every bit!

panels.stage: A blue current thread passes music room, then stage arch, then curls toward shops, bathhouse and tram; arrows belong only to planning, no new power source.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: The current carries our evening song. The shops answer, then the bathhouse, then the tram.

panels.stage: Residents prepare for the evening; projected shop pictograms, shell bowls and peach window lamps.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Windows were opening. Tables were filling. Soon, the first song would begin.

panels.stage: Bubble tram approaches overhead. A loose kelp leaf traces the low clear arch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan raced after the tram bubbles.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Our path is underneath. Watch the leaf.

panels.stage: Tram passes; one short water pulse bends the kelp. Rumi rests a hand on the pillar; Roshan copies.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: WHOOSH! The passing tram swept the water sideways.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Hold here. Let the rush pass.

panels.stage: Pulse settles; both follow the leaf around the pillar instead of fighting against it.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Now it curves this way!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: She slowed her tail. The water carried them through.

panels.stage: Duri with his basket of small bells and a stage banner. Mint floral shell and four lavender flippers fully readable.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I'm Duri. These bells invite our neighbours to the song. This banner goes to the stage.

panels.stage: One bell drifts to kelp; Roshan uses the curling current learned on p4.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Ding! One bell escaped. Roshan followed the leaf, turned low and caught it.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: You saw the little way through!

panels.stage: Duri points to the bridge route, then his bulky banner. Roshan offers to share the load.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Can we help carry it?

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I'll manage. Meet you after my round!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Off he paddled, basket wobbling.

panels.stage: Music room: Rumi joins tall copper-haired Hana and younger navy-bobbed Nari. Distinct costumes and one-tail anatomy.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I'm Hana. I dance BIG!

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: I'm Nari. I hear tiny things.

panels.stage: Hana begins a broad turn; her costume ribbon brushes Nari. Nari holds her small shell drum.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Room for one small drummer, please!

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Oops. Smaller turn.

panels.stage: Hana makes room; Roshan sits inside the trio formation rather than outside it.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: We take turns. Sing, listen, answer.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I can try the listening part.

panels.stage: Trio begins a quiet original refrain. Roshan watches their breathing.

entries.speaker: Trio
entries.text:
Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me.

panels.stage: Hana encourages enthusiastically; Nari makes a gap between drumbeats for Roshan.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Your turn!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan tried a note. It vanished beneath the drum.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: I'll leave you a space.

panels.stage: Nari pauses; the trio listens. Roshan tries again, heard at close range.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: La...

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: There you are.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: For one little moment, Roshan liked her own voice.

panels.stage: The trio sends the next line toward the open windows; map echoes p3 landmarks.

entries.speaker: Trio
entries.text:
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.

panels.stage: Three small views: quiet shop window, bathhouse curtain, tram ribbons barely moving.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: No answer from the shops. None from the bathhouse. Even the tram was quiet.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Maybe we need to sing louder?

panels.stage: Roshan hears an uneven tiny tap between the notes; her hand rises before Hana can drown it out.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Wait. I heard something.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Tap. Tap. Then nothing.

panels.stage: Nari stops drumming. Roshan separates irregular tapping from a bell ringing.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: A courier bell?

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: No. Someone is knocking.

panels.stage: They reach the bridge. Sound seems to come from two arches; show left kelp route and right open echo chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Under the bridge, the tapping bounced from arch to arch.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: This way!

panels.stage: Hana swims toward the loud echo, finds an empty recess and turns back. A meaningful wrong first route.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Hana found only stone. The loudest sound was an echo.

panels.stage: Roshan holds still; Nari leaves a silent gap. A faint tap comes from the low kelp arch.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Let it finish.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: There. Under the fronds.

panels.stage: Roshan follows a leaf toward the low arch. Rumi keeps Hana and Nari together.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: A little leaf curled into the same opening. Roshan followed it.

panels.stage: A tram approaches above. The fronds begin to lean; Roshan recognises the setup from p4.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: The tram! Hold the pillar.

panels.stage: Pulse passes; all four maintain their holds. No separation or injury.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: WHOOSH! Kelp streamed across the entrance. The friends held on.

panels.stage: Rumi keeps kelp aside once the pulse settles. Roshan leads with a small tail turn.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Now. One at a time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan slipped low. Hana folded her great fan fin close.

panels.stage: Nari carries drum close to chest through the gap rather than letting it snag.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: No big drumbeats here!

panels.stage: At the inner recess they see Duri tapping from between two crates. Clear establishing view before close-ups.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Beyond the kelp, a lantern lit two crates. Between them was Duri.

panels.stage: Two empty concert prop crates rest on a sloping stone ledge. Duri fits between them but cannot turn his shell. Banner loop catches his shell and nearer crate corner.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I tried to move these boxes out of the path. They slid together.

panels.stage: Close on loop and floral shell; no neck constriction, wounds or frightening crushing.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Then the banner caught. I can paddle, but I can't turn.

panels.stage: Duri taps crate with one free flipper. Roshan answers by touching the same crate.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: We heard you. We're staying here.

panels.stage: Hana begins pushing the nearer crate; the cloth draws tight instead of freeing Duri.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I can make a space!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The crate moved. The loop tightened.

panels.stage: Roshan immediately stops the push. All hands hold stable; Duri remains safe.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Stop! That cloth has to come free first.

panels.stage: Overhead close plan: nearer crate/banner corner, Duri in gap, far crate held by Hana; same orientation as p11.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan looked at the corner, the loop and Duri's shell.

panels.stage: Roshan gently moves nearer crate back just enough to slacken cloth, without undoing any completed rescue.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: A tiny bit this way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The loop loosened.

panels.stage: Rumi places fingers under loose fabric, clear hand-shell contact.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: I can lift it. Keep this crate still.

panels.stage: Roshan takes nearer crate; Hana far crate. Nari positions where she can see overhead tram and all hands.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Hana, hold that one. Nari, watch the bridge.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: I'll tell you when the water changes.

panels.stage: Rumi lifts the loop over the widest shell edge while Duri folds his flippers in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Duri tucked in. Rumi lifted slowly. The cloth rose over his shell.

panels.stage: Banner is fully off Duri; the freed cloth floats above his shell. First concrete gained state.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: The loop is free!

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I can turn a little!

panels.stage: Nari sees tram lanterns crossing above; kelp and hair bend before the pulse.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Here comes the rush! Hold!

panels.stage: Pulse nudges nearer crate along slope. Roshan braces; Hana keeps far crate stable; Rumi supports Duri.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: WHOOSH! Roshan's crate slid a hand-width. She planted both hands against it.

panels.stage: Duri's basket lifts; loose bells join it in one visible eddy/kelp pocket behind pillar, just beyond safe recess. No renewed cloth entanglement or offscreen lost bells.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: My bells!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: His basket tipped into the curling water.

panels.stage: Roshan starts to reach for basket; crate begins turning. Her decision has an immediate visible consequence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan reached after it. The crate shifted.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Stay with Duri. The bells can wait!

panels.stage: Roshan returns both hands to brace; Rumi keeps Duri safe. Nari tracks basket circling a clear recess behind pillar; no risky mid-rescue recovery.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan held her place. Nari watched the basket circle behind the pillar.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: I can still see it!

panels.stage: Pulse ends; Nari checks fronds, then counts. Hana and Roshan have maintained stable crate positions.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: The water is quiet. One. Two. Gently.

panels.stage: Roshan slides nearer crate sideways off slope onto adjacent flat patch; Hana steadies far crate. Gap opens behind Duri.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan pushed sideways. This time, the space stayed open.

panels.stage: Duri turns shell edge-on into newly opened gap and backs into Roshan's now-free hands, all four flippers free. Nearer crate rests on flat patch.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Back toward me, Duri.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Four little flippers paddled. Duri backed clear.

panels.stage: Primary action: now Duri is free, Hana slides far bridge crate off slope onto separate flat patch. Roshan/Duri safe in supporting background; their clear offpanel speech continues. Both crates stable before departure.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Hana settled the other box on flat stone.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: You didn't leave me.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: You kept tapping. We kept listening.

panels.stage: Now Duri is safely free, Nari points to same eddy/kelp pocket; Rumi follows curling water, scoops loose bells into basket then catches basket. No new trap or lost possessions.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: There's the basket!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Rumi scooped the loose bells into it. The whole delivery came home.

panels.stage: Duri accepts shared carrying; Hana takes banner, Rumi basket. Nari taps a quiet reply.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Will you carry these with me?

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Gladly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Tap. Tap. Tap. This time, four friends answered.

panels.stage: Quiet mint tiled bathhouse. Duri's towel and all four flippers readable; Nari's cream bunny-ear towel appears here.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: At the bathhouse, warm water untangled their hair and hurried feelings.

panels.stage: Roshan and Duri share a candid closer view; others listen without talking over them.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I thought I had to carry everything myself.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I nearly chased your bells. I forgot you needed my hands.

panels.stage: Rumi squeezes Roshan's hand. Roshan acknowledges reliance on the others.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Then you stayed. We could help because you let us.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I was scared. I'm glad you were there.

panels.stage: Hana notices Nari's towel ears; Duri relaxes flippers and laughs. Gentle landing after action.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Are we singers or sea bunnies?

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Very clean sea bunnies!

panels.stage: Preserve selected lavish feast: wide coral table filling foreground, three piled clusters of gimbap/golden snacks, tiered sweets/side dishes and fruit, four shell cups. Original selected food/table source controls design.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Supper filled a great coral table: seaweed rolls, golden dumplings, fruit towers and little cakes.

panels.stage: Hana sprawls on cream couch; Duri waits for a small seat. Do not obscure Hana's face with repeated fin crops.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I dance BIG. I rest BIG too.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Room for one small turtle, please.

panels.stage: Hana folds long fin; Duri settles beside Roshan. Basket is parked safely nearby.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Hana folded her fin. Duri chose a tiny cake from an enormous plate.

panels.stage: Roshan starts quiet original line; friends join. Warm expressive group moment before interruption.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Make a space and let it through.

entries.speaker: Everyone
entries.text: There's a place for me and you.

panels.stage: Same feast and cream couch. Magician enters through curtain with top hat; performer unfurls a banner with same motif as rescue cloth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: POOF! A top hat bobbed through the curtain.

entries.speaker: Magician Imp
entries.text: Make way for our spectacular show!

panels.stage: Performer's banner floats above table without sweeping food away. Duri rises beside Rumi, recognises design.

entries.speaker: Performer Imp
entries.text: Enormous scenery! Enormous voices!

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: That's your banner. Your boxes trapped me.

panels.stage: Duri points toward stage; distinguish three additional gate crates from the two bridge crates.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I saw three more under the stage.

entries.speaker: Magician Imp
entries.text: Our finest props! Nobody touch them!

panels.stage: Imps hurry off to stage. Roshan makes a decision; trio follows, Duri can choose safe route with them.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: The city stopped answering. We need to see what those props are blocking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: They left the feast and followed the banner.

panels.stage: Show stage above and golden current arch below: two small forward crates and one larger rear crate, independently floor-supported; weak blue thread beneath. Public song route visible beyond arch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Three crates crowded the current arch. The ribbons above it hardly stirred.

panels.stage: Stage-side imps practise loud duet; voices remain nearby, distant windows remain quiet.

entries.speaker: Performer Imp
entries.text: LOUDER! Why won't anybody cheer?

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: They can't hear you through all that scenery.

panels.stage: Roshan sees blue thread under large crate, tying to p4 leaf and rescue route.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: There's a little way through. But not enough room for the song.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The magic was still there. The path was blocked.

panels.stage: Duri pauses near bridge after frightening experience; Roshan offers companionable hand/flipper contact, not a forced return.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I know the service passage. It's narrow.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: We'll go together.

panels.stage: Duri confidently leads low path behind pillar. Hana folds fin, Nari listens at bend; completed rescue not threatened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Duri turned beneath the bridge. Hana followed with small, careful turns.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Big fin. Little doorway.

panels.stage: Passage opens beside right storage ledge below stage; show ledge clear, outside straight outflow and large enough for all three crates.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Here. I leave parcels on that flat ledge.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: A safe place for the props!

panels.stage: Clear spatial plan: arch centre/low, stage above, right storage ledge outside straight outflow, safe pillar left rear. Two small crates beside/in front of square-aligned large crate, all independently supported on floor; no stack.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Move the small boxes first. Then the big one. Keep the arch clear.

panels.stage: Hana tests banner as a broad soft catcher; Nari taps and pauses; Duri observes ledge from safe pillar.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I can catch their flying props.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: I can count the moves.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I'll watch the way out.

panels.stage: Rumi floats beside Roshan; request comes before combat. Nari's bathhouse towel was removed offpanel between17and18; mint hooded jacket/peach collar remain.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: I'll stay beside you.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: First, let's ask them to help.

panels.stage: Roshan faces costumed imps at shell stage. The three gate crates and unused right ledge visible in context; two bridge crates stay at bridge.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Your bridge boxes trapped Duri. These ones are blocking our song. Will you move them?

panels.stage: Performer reacts defensively; motive is being heard, not a new evil conspiracy.

entries.speaker: Performer Imp
entries.text: We made the biggest show. We need the biggest scenery!

panels.stage: Roshan points to safe ledge and silent shop windows, offering concrete solution.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: It can stand here. Then your neighbours can answer.

panels.stage: Magician refuses, then begins bubble puff with purple hand. Preserve navy coat/top hat/red bow tie/trousers/shoes and original bare purple hands; no new gloves, cape or costume transformation.

entries.speaker: Magician Imp
entries.text: Nobody moves our props!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: He flicked his hand. POOF!

panels.stage: A directional bubble wall separates stage approach from crates. Roshan brakes; head and hands readable through clear space.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Bubbles rolled across the arch. Roshan stopped before they swept her sideways.

panels.stage: Performer tosses foam star; Hana opens rescue banner across its flight line.

entries.speaker: Performer Imp
entries.text: Our dazzling star!

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Our very soft catcher!

panels.stage: Banner bows and catches star. Hana braces fin against stage edge while floating, no mermaid feet; Nari ducks clearly beneath it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: WHUMP! The star landed in the cloth. Nari ducked beneath its corner.

panels.stage: Rumi starts a distinct original work-song; Hana/Nari join while catching/counting. Singing coordinates physical moves, never acts as an attack or removes crates.

entries.speaker: Trio
entries.text: Catch the star and let it sway.

panels.stage: Roshan watches rising bubbles, not trying to outsing them. Duri points to low current from safe pillar.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Below!

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I see it.

panels.stage: Bubble wall cycles upward with a clear interval beneath. Roshan follows blue thread with her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: A puff rose. Another followed. Between them, the little blue current kept curling.

panels.stage: Nari leaves one drumbeat silent so she can hear the next puff starting.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Wait for it...

panels.stage: Magician draws breath for puff; Rumi pivots aside. Roshan remains braced until interval.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Rumi spun clear. The bubbles swept past the empty space.

panels.stage: Nari signals clear low interval. One readable diagonal dive, one-tail anatomy, no whole-body blur.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Now, Roshan!

panels.stage: Roshan folds low, swims beneath cloud and turns at pillar in same direction as learned p4 route.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan dipped, turned and followed the blue thread under the bubbles.

panels.stage: She reaches first small crate from below. Establish successful position before next task; Rumi answers with next work-song line before following.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I'm through. Rumi, this side!

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Make a little swimming way.

panels.stage: Rumi follows same timed gap. Hana holds foam catcher above; Nari counts from stage edge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Rumi slipped through after her. Above them, Hana kept the star out of their way.

panels.stage: Roshan and Rumi each have visible two-hand contact on first small crate; slide to right ledge.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: One. Two. Gently!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The first little crate slid onto the flat ledge.

panels.stage: Duri confirms first crate flat/stable from nearby safe position, without heavy lifting.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: It's flat. Leave it there!

panels.stage: Rumi and Roshan repeat with second small crate, altered approach because blue thread is clearer. First remains on ledge.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: The next one. Turn this corner toward me.

panels.stage: Second settles beside first; Nari sees ribbons begin stirring. Larger crate still blocks main arch. Rumi swims back up to stage, Roshan stays by large crate.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Two boxes out. The ribbons trembled. Rumi swam back up to the stage.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: One big box to go.

entries.speaker: Trio
entries.text: Leave a beat and keep it slow.

panels.stage: Performer pulls banner edge to reclaim star, making cloth taut. Hana stays balanced and offers release rather than tug-of-war.

entries.speaker: Performer Imp
entries.text: Give back our star!

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Here it comes!

panels.stage: Hana tilts soft catcher and Nari tips star with drum rim, directing it to padded cushions already by performer. No hard strike.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Hana tipped the cloth. Nari nudged the foam star toward the cushion pile.

panels.stage: Star drifts into performer's arms; backward surprise step lands him on cushions, safe and comical.

entries.speaker: Performer Imp
entries.text: Oof!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: He sat down in a great squash of pillows.

panels.stage: Magician aims broad puff in response; own broad bubble stream lifts/tilts hat over eyes. Clear causal puff-hat contact detail, same costume.

entries.speaker: Magician Imp
entries.text: An even bigger POOF!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: His bubbles flipped his hat over his eyes.

panels.stage: Rumi offers elbow/hand to guide magician onto same cushions instead of leaving him blind to stumble.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Cushions this way.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Big moves. Soft finish.

panels.stage: Residual final bubble puff drifts between Roshan below and friends above. Two cleared crates remain safe; no regression.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The last big puff hid the arch. Roshan was already beside the final crate.

panels.stage: Hana passes the now-empty rescue banner down to Roshan through last thinning puff. Show explicit handoff; performer's interruption banner remains a different prop.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: Try this!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Hana passed the soft banner down to Roshan.

panels.stage: Roshan loops freed end of banner through large crate handle; cloth can reach up to ledge, no tied actor limbs.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I can pull it like the little ones.

panels.stage: She pulls straight toward right ledge; square crate skews diagonally and trailing corner catches a short side projection of right arch jamb. Floor is flat with open pivot space in front; no full-width threshold.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The box moved, turned and stuck.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Come on...

panels.stage: Close on caught corner, short side lip and taut cloth; she stops pulling, learned snag inspection echoed from p11.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: She pulled harder. The corner pressed harder too. Roshan let the cloth go slack.

panels.stage: Roshan calls to friends across residual bubbles; loud hiss masks call. Show why no immediate answer comes, rather than making friends ignore her.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I need you!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: HISSS! The last puff rushed over her voice.

panels.stage: Bubbles hide hand signal but their hiss is fading. Roshan taps crate three times as Duri did in rescue; Duri hears knock through quieter interval from safe route.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The bubbles hid her wave. She knocked instead. Tap. Tap. Tap.

panels.stage: Nari pauses drumming; Duri identifies Roshan's taps. Rumi and Hana turn toward arch.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: That's Roshan!

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Leave a space. Listen.

panels.stage: Friends use low gap; Duri guides along safe corridor, not through a renewed trap.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: They followed Duri beneath the last bubbles. Roshan was waiting, hands resting on the crate.

panels.stage: Duri points to short side projection/diagonal corner and demonstrates small turn with bell basket. Show free floor/pivot arc beside jamb, drawing on courier experience.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: My parcels catch there too. Turn the corner first. Then slide.

panels.stage: Roshan assigns contacts: Hana pushes far corner into open forecourt; Roshan guides near corner; Rumi keeps banner slack during rotation; Nari counts; Duri watches from outside pivot path.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Hana, turn that corner. Rumi, keep the cloth loose. Duri, tell us when it's clear.

panels.stage: Short rotation around floor-supported near corner swings caught trailing corner away from short jamb lip into open forecourt; show gained clearance before any sideways pull. Rumi's banner remains slack.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: One. Two. Turn!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The corner swung away from the stone.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Clear!

panels.stage: Maintain rotated crate from p27; after Duri's Clear, Rumi takes banner with Roshan and pulls; Hana supports far edge. Reset grips for sideways slide without losing orientation.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Rumi, pull with me. Now slide. Together!

panels.stage: Crate moves onto right ledge beside two smaller crates; arch progressively revealed. Big action panel, consistent geography.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: SWISH! The last box slid clear. Three boxes rested safely at the side.

panels.stage: Full golden arch now clear. Blue current flows to shops/bathhouse/tram; hanging ribbons lift, no new magic source. Trio completes work-song after physical clearing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: A blue ribbon of water curled through the arch. The stage ribbons lifted and danced.

entries.speaker: Trio
entries.text: Turn together. Let it flow.

panels.stage: Duri swims through safe cleared opening with basket and rings one bell. First reply reaches friends.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Time to finish my round!

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Ding! A little answer came back from the first open window.

panels.stage: Both imps sit safely on pillows; quiet song reaches them. Performer looks at reopened route, not just defeat pose.

entries.speaker: Performer Imp
entries.text: They're singing now. Why didn't they sing for us?

panels.stage: Roshan points to clear arch and stable side props; explanation grounded in visible change.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Your scenery blocked the way. A bigger show couldn't fix that.

panels.stage: Magician addresses Duri as he passes, with apology and an offered practical task.

entries.speaker: Magician Imp
entries.text: We didn't mean to trap you. Can we help?

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Keep that path open.

panels.stage: Imps fold loose cloth/tidy cushions away from route. No reblocking or destruction of costume identity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: They folded their banner and tucked the cushions safely beside the stage.

panels.stage: Hana gives them space at edge of ensemble, not exclusive centre. Nari sets a small answering beat.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: There's room for your big moves too.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: And a little pause after them!

panels.stage: Duri's genuine delivery sequence: first shop neighbour receives bell; chorus carried by clear current, no invented named cast.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Duri rang at the shops. One neighbour answered. Then two.

panels.stage: Bathhouse doorway: familiar mint tiles; another bell delivered, neighbours hum.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: He rang at the bathhouse. Warm voices joined the tune.

panels.stage: Tram platform: bell and fluttering ribbons. Tram passes without threatening cleared props; p4 pulse now harmless.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: At the tram, bells chimed. The song came all the way back.

panels.stage: Stage ensemble: trio plus Roshan, Duri returns to them, costumed imps at sides. Roshan starts her own note confidently.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: My turn.

entries.speaker: Everyone
entries.text:
Little voice, big blue sea.
Sing with you, sing with me.

panels.stage: Wide city response as map pays off. Hold uncluttered faces and broad expressive figures.

entries.speaker: Everyone
entries.text:
Make a space and let it through.
There's a place for me and you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan sang. Then she left a space for the answer.

panels.stage: Return via pool portal, same seahorse fountain and rainbow. Castle boundary explicit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Roshan and Rumi swam back to the pool. The rainbow was still turning.

panels.stage: Quiet honest connection to wider unresolved story, no new quest or candle clue.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: We haven't found the candle.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: No. But you helped a whole neighbourhood find its voice.

panels.stage: Roshan chooses to answer distant courier taps with a tap of her own. Close the personal arc through action.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Far below came three little taps.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I hear you.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: She tapped three times back.

pages.title: A little voice. A whole city listening.

panels.stage: Illustrated back: cast gathered in familiar neighbourhood, open arch and stored crates subtly visible. Separate future cover view, not a claimed existing action frame.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Tap. Tap. Tap.
